svg.title: A /turbocharge:brainstorm session, step by step
svg.desc: The session starts with /turbocharge:brainstorm and the skill announcing itself. 1, size it: quick gets done now with no design doc, small agrees the approach in chat, project goes on to a design doc. 2, one question per message, multiple choice when it can: What problem are you solving, and who hits it today? 3, two or three approaches, the recommended one first. 4, the design in sections of 200 to 300 words, with Does this look right? after each. 5, builder check: a researcher reads the doc as the developer who will build it; its questions become answers in the doc, minor calls marked Ruled in brainstorm:, or one message for you. 6, the design goes to docs/plans/<date>-<topic>-design.md, committed, then /turbocharge:story or /turbocharge:plan.

text.font-family: 'Space Mono Bold', 'Space Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: QUESTIONS FIRST. THEN A DESIGN DOC.

text.font-family: 'Space Mono Bold', 'Space Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace
